content.title: What time do new FROM episodes come out? Here's the Season 4 release schedule for the Amazon MGM+ series
content.text: If you click on a link and make a purchase we may receive a small commission. Read our editorial policy.The fourth season of MGM+'s hit horror series is here, and we can tell you exactly when the mysteries will be revealed with a schedule for the 10-episode seasonAmazon MGM’s supernatural series FROM returns April 19 on MGM+, ending an anxious wait for new episodes. Creeping out of the forest, the season promises to reveal some of the core mysteries about the town everyone is trapped in, but what time do new episodes come out, and when can you watch them? We’re here to tell you when the new episodes will drop - and what they're called - with a full release schedule. What time are FROM Season 4 episodes coming out? FROM Season 4 debuts 9pm Eastern, 8pm Central on April 19, 2026. New episodes will follow weekly at the same release time every Sunday through June 21. FROM Season 4 release schedule and titles FROM season 4 episode number FROM season 4 episode title FROM season 4 episode release date 1 The Arrival April 19, 2026 2 Fray April 26, 2026 3 Merrily We Go May 3, 2026 4 Of Myths and Monsters May 10, 2026 5 What a Long Strange Trip it’s Been May 17, 2026 6 The Heart is a Lonely Hunter May 24, 2026 7 Best Laid Plans May 31, 2026 8 Heavy is the Head June 7, 2026 9 The Calm Before June 14, 2026 10 If a Tree Falls in the Forest June 21, 2026 What if FROM Season 4 about? The official plot description from Amazon MGM Studios for the season runs as follows: “In Season Four, the closer the residents of town get to the answers they seek, the more terrifying their search becomes. Who is the Man in Yellow, and what does he want? Will Jade and Tabitha’s revelation be the key to finally going home? How much longer can Boyd hold the town together, even as his body and mind are falling apart? And what role will the town’s most recent arrival play in the events to come? Season Four will open doors that some in town will end up wishing had remained closed.” Is there a FROM Season 4 trailer? Yes, there is. Whether it’s the panicked cast members, the suitably portentous captions (“The wait is over,” indeed), or just the general vibe, the trailer for the next season seems appropriately creepy. Watch for yourself. Want to know more about FROM? We’ve got a guide to everything you need to know before the fourth season begins right here. FROM Season 4 begins on MGM+ April 19.
